Dear Mr. Vega,

Re: Account ID: ACC-970127

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the identity of the account holder, claiming that the account was included in your bankruptcy and is not a legitimate debt.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute and provide you with a written validation of the debt, if it is deemed to be legitimate. We will conduct an investigation into the matter and will respond to your dispute in a timely manner.

We have reviewed the account information and confirmed that the original creditor is Frontier State Bank. The account was charged off on November 3, 2021, and the current balance is $4,831.67. Unfortunately, we do not have any record of a payment being made on this account.

We will provide you with a written validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA, within the next 30 days. If our investigation confirms that the account is legitimate, we will provide you with the validation and continue to attempt to collect the debt. However, if our investigation confirms that the account is not legitimate, we will cease all collection activities and remove the account from our records.

You have the right to dispute this account further if you believe that our investigation does not adequately address your concerns. You may also request that we provide you with additional information or documentation regarding the account.

Please note that this letter is not an admission of liability and is merely a response to your dispute. We appreciate your cooperation in this matter and look forward to resolving this dispute in a fair and timely manner.

Sincerely,

Trident Portfolio Services
